data.title: 楪祈 · 屋顶对话
data.description: 黄昏的临海天台旁可以看见防波堤。楪祈坐在混凝土沿上，双腿轻轻垂下，双手捧着尚有余温的红茶罐。晚风吹动粉橘渐变长发，她侧过头望向同行者，赤红眼眸里流露出安静的信任。
data.action: 坐在临海天台沿上，双手捧温红茶罐，侧头望向同行者
data.camera: full body, seated figure and dangling legs visible
data.promptProse: Inori cradles the warm tea can in both hands on the broad parapet, turning attentively toward the viewer beside her. The sea below fades into orange-grey dusk as the breeze lifts the ends of her pink hair.
data.animaCaption: Both hands cradle the tea while she turns toward the viewer beside her.
